texto: Explain a news, produce a connected text and review the result. **Min slutsats bygger på exempel** means «My conclusion is based on two examples». It relates the expression to the purpose of the text. Look at the connectors and reformulate the idea with your own words before you respond. Sequence 3 of 3: incorporates this expression and reviews the above.
